observations: Photo 0 shows a black plastic automotive part, likely a body panel or fender liner, lying on a wooden surface.
The part has a curved shape with cutouts and mounting points, typical of a car body component.
There is a watermark or text overlay on the image that says 'HONDA AND ACURA' in white letters.
The part appears to be made of molded plastic with some visible wear or scratches.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the part itself.
The seller claims it is for all models of Acura and Honda cars and SUVs.

claims.claim: Engine, suspension n body parts for all model of acura n honda cars n suvs
claims.evidence: The part shown is a body panel, not an engine or suspension component. The claim about 'all models' cannot be verified from the photo alone. The watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA' is present but does not confirm compatibility with all models.

risks.risk: The part may not fit the intended vehicle models as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the part installed on a specific car model or a close-up of the part's mounting points matching known Acura/Honda models.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incompatible or for general use only, not for specific models

risks.risk: The part may be damaged or cracked, which is not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo showing the entire surface of the part, especially edges and corners, to check for cracks, warping, or missing pieces.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, reducing value

risks.risk: The part may be counterfeit or not genuine Acura/Honda component.
risks.proof: A photo of the part's underside or back showing any part number, VIN tag, or manufacturer label, or a photo of the part installed on a known Acura/Honda vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, lower value

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or transmission bay showing the condition of the components.
A clear photo of the part's mounting points and any part numbers or labels.
A photo of the part installed on a specific Acura or Honda vehicle, if available.
Close-up of the entire surface of the part to check for damage or cracks.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
